description: Platform-specific delivery specs. Single source of truth read by scaffold-project.sh, /render, and the /music command. Add a preset by giving its constraints — never hard-code platform specs in command bodies or stage docs.

safe_zone.rationale: Instagram UI overlays: top 18% has profile + share buttons; bottom 20% has caption bar + audio chip; right 22% has like/comment/share column. Subtitles and supers must stay outside these bands.

reels-vertical.notes: Marketing uploads the platform_clean variant muted and adds licensed music in Instagram UI. Internal-review variant carries the proposed bed + cues sheet. Safe zones derived from smoke-test #1 manual safe-zone fix.

safe_zone.rationale: TikTok bottom-zone is taller (caption + username + audio + buttons). Right column carries like/comment/share. Treat 25% bottom + 25% right as no-go for important content.
Shorts UI is lighter than Reels/TikTok. Subscribe button bottom-center; like/dislike right column.

shorts-vertical.notes: YouTube has Audio Library inside Studio but most creators bake in. Default to royalty-free baked unless project says otherwise.

safe_zone.rationale: Feed-style autoplay muted; minimal UI overlay. Burn-in subtitles must always be visible inside the 80% central band.
Long-form: title-bar at top hides during playback; progress bar at bottom claims ~10% on mobile. End-screen cards occupy lower-right last 20s.

internal_review.description: Watch-and-approve artifact for the marketing team. Music baked in as a PROPOSAL so reviewers see what the agent is suggesting. Never distributed publicly. Suffix: _INTERNAL_REVIEW.

platform_clean.description: Picture-locked deliverable with dialogue+sfx+ambient, no music stem. Marketing uploads this muted and adds licensed music inside the platform UI. Suffix: _CLEAN_FOR_UI_MUSIC.

platform_final.description: Picture + final audio mix (including baked-in licensed or royalty-free music). For platforms that don't auto-license inside the UI (YouTube long-form, broadcast handoff).

music_modes.baked-royalty-free: Music sourced from FMA/Jamendo/Pixabay/Mixkit/NCS/YT-Audio-Library and baked into the output. Default for Shorts/LinkedIn/YouTube-long.
music_modes.baked-licensed: Music from a user-supplied licensed source, baked in. Requires manifest.music.license_proof.
music_modes.internal-reference: Proposed track baked into the internal_review variant only. NEVER baked into platform_clean. The platform-clean variant ships music-free; reviewers compare against the internal_review to approve the editorial proposal. Used for Reels/TikTok where music is added in the platform UI.
music_modes.none: Silent piece OR dialogue/sfx only. Music skipped per editorial choice.
